memo_key: Exact newly read immutable builtin bytes, never path/mtime/expected digest
history_scope: New memo per invocation; statistics copied and keys explicitly cleared in finally
pre_run_review_changes: Explicit finally cleanup prevents exec-created cycles from retaining memo key payloads; snapshots remain pre-clear statistics.
PLAN now accurately limits failure evidence to completed records plus caught exception, with no guarantee for in-progress observations or hard-kill RESULT.
limitations: All counts are prospective source/metadata predictions; no candidate execution result is certified here.
Payload SHA counters are not total-program hashing cost. Logical IO remains unchanged and dictionary/content comparison adds cost.
Temporary-file qualification is trusted-local change detection, not an adversarial filesystem or race guarantee.
No timing screen, CPU speedup claim, complete-subtree budget proof or strict256 admission.
Worker lock release does not establish outer termination; whole-child cost plus outer prefix omits a nonzero final tail and preparation/review/history.
Execution needs parent admission. No automatic retry, cache-size sweep, production integration, deployment, training or relaxation of existing holds.
